title: Parse User
statement: Implement `solve(name, age)`. `name` must be a non-blank string after strip. `age` must be an int, not a bool, and must be >= 0. The tests pass age as an int, or the string `bool` when the payload used a JSON boolean. Return `{"name": stripped, "age": age}` or `error`.
hints: Reject the string bool before any numeric use.
Strip the name and reject empty.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Pydantic will coerce some values and reject others depending on the model.

editorial: Pydantic will coerce some values and reject others depending on the model. A bool accepted as an age is the subclass trap. This function is the validation you want even if you write it by hand: non-empty name, real int, non-negative.
